ctx.x: Yeah. And I want to hear about the closing of the show, and why, and what happened to you.

Well, we closed in -- we had a reason for closing. Because, again, the work of Goldberg. Cause we was all tired of it anyhow. We had money and we was all tired of the show. But Goldberg showed -- Leonidow was backed out now. Was -- Sirotq, Sirotq. And Plaskoff was his secretary. Plaskoff was -- both of them were Polish people, you see. And Plaskoff tried to keep the thing together, but Goldberg influenced Sirotq that, 'Look, you're paying these people too much money. And we can get cheaper talent around here. And…
